messages:
deploy-bot: :rotating_light: Deploy canary started for release/2026.03.15 - route: inference-service-canary - initiating 5% rollout
oncall-bot: Paging user sam.w (on-call)
sam.w: got the page, looking now. can you post which namespace?
deploy-bot: namespace: production-inference, cluster: eu-central-1
sam.w: checking pods `kubectl -n production-inference get pods -l app=inference-canary`
sam.w: seeing 3/5 crashlooping, logs show `panic: env var MODEL_PATH not set`
maria-eng: oh no — the canary manifest lost the configmap mount for MODEL_PATH in the canary overlay
liam.sre: on it — can you paste the exact pod logs
sam.w: ```
2026-03-15T06:12:03Z INF starting
panic: env var MODEL_PATH not set
goroutine 1 [running]:
main.main()
...
```
jess.product: any customer impact? alerts from the API gateway?
ops-lead: gateway 502 spikes correlated with canary traffic to inference route. Affects ~2% of requests, mostly short text generation calls
liam.sre: suspect mispatched configmap + HPA reacting. HPA upscaled to 20 replicas, then pods started crashlooping, kubelet killing older ones, cascading
maria-eng: confirmed overlay omitted `volumeMounts` for `model-config` — looks like a bad kustomize patch
sam.w: will pause rollout and flip traffic to stable
sam.w: `/deploy rollback inference-service --to stable --wait` -> done, traffic back to stable
deploy-bot: Canary rollout paused, traffic reverted to stable, canary pods being terminated
liam.sre: to stop user impact: set feature flag `enable_canary_inference` -> false (LaunchDarkly) — Maria can you flip?
maria-eng: done. LD flag set to false. :white_check_mark:
jess.product: thanks. CS reports drop in 502s
sam.w: preparing postmortem notes. Steps: 1) investigate kustomize overlay diff 2) add CI check for missing volumeMounts 3) add canary circuit-breaker to HPA policy
ops-lead: recommend automated pre-rollout verify script to ensure configmap mounts present
liam.sre: oncall handoff in 20m — liam taking lead for next 12h. sam handing off context.
sam.w: handing off to liam.sre — all stable, monitoring for 30m, if errors >1% re-escalate.
oncall-bot: Incident created PD-INC-8892 severity: low-medium. Participants pinned: sam.w, liam.sre, maria-eng, jess.product
jess.product: will notify a handful of affected customers with a short note: "we briefly rolled back a canary due to config issue, no persistent data loss, monitoring"
maria-eng: creating PR to fix overlay now: https://git.internal/repo/patches/1234
liam.sre: log snippet and pod manifests attached in incident doc
sam.w: closing thread here, will update postmortem draft in #postmortems
sam.w: :thumbsup:
